description.value: Nature's Fare Markets is a well-established natural and organic grocery chain that has served Penticton since 1998, moving to this larger Main Street location in 2018. The store carries certified organic produce, ethically sourced meat and dairy, vitamins, and clean beauty products alongside a Bistro offering local, organic grab-and-go meals, entrees, and smoothies. With over 40 employees and a long-tenured store manager, it functions as a full-service health-focused supermarket — a strong resupply point for cyclists seeking quality whole foods.
